goal: Blend existing AI Makeup with the original person skin tone while retaining visible cosmetics.
mechanism: Source-only color-reference alignment; automatic neutral skin/neck samples; smooth spatial Lab correction across facial cosmetics and head/neck transitions. No displayed geometry warp.
development_receipt: Boundary-only Poisson probe on six saved outputs improved warmth but left uneven internal tone; not adopted.
Initial spatial-field version matched color but hard-protected whole lips and semantic head edges, creating visible seams; rejected locally.
Revised spatial field includes cosmetic/head/neck transitions and uses narrow inner-eye/neutral-teeth protection. Previous failed outputs preserved.

visual_review.finding: White/pale cast visibly reduced, cosmetics remain visible and gross v1 lip/face cutout borders reduced.
visual_review.remaining: Warm/orange shading, lip/brow color shifts, some hairline/jaw/neck transitions and pre-existing smoothing/geometry changes remain possible. Not an accepted universal fix.

protection_limit: Only pixels outside actual edit influence are raw-identical. Lip, brow, neck, narrow hairline and nearby background pixels can change. Whole lips/whole semantic face boundaries are not hard protected.

performance.limit: Local CPU only. Correction excludes parser/model loading/file IO. Original-source maps reused; full two-parser Kaggle latency/RAM not measured.

next: User reviews actual source/raw/corrected gallery. If appearance is useful, validate additional permitted inputs/pose/mask failure cases and actual Kaggle CPU memory/time before a separate versioned serving integration with unchanged raw-model provenance and fallback. No automatic promotion/sweep.
